UAL1.label: Quaternius Universal Animation Library 1
UAL1.origin: Universal Animation Library by Quaternius: the free Standard edition (45 clips and a T-pose), as Quaternius exports it for Godot

UAL2.label: Quaternius Universal Animation Library 2
UAL2.origin: Universal Animation Library 2 by Quaternius: the free Standard edition (42 clips), as Quaternius exports it for Unreal and Godot

A_TPose: T-pose, arms straight out: the rest pose every clip is measured from
Idle_Loop: standing at rest, breathing and shifting weight
Idle_Talking_Loop: standing and talking with hand gestures
Idle_Torch_Loop: standing with one arm raised, holding up a torch or lantern
Sprint_Loop: full sprint with big arm swings, in place
Crouch_Idle_Loop: crouched low and still, looking about
Jump_Start: dips, then springs up with the arms thrown out (in place: the game lifts the body)
Jump_Loop: airborne pose held while rising or falling
Jump_Land: lands from a fall, knees soak it up, stands
Roll: forward roll over the shoulder and back to standing, in place
Punch_Enter: brings the fists up into a fighting stance
Punch_Jab: quick lead-hand jab from the stance
Punch_Cross: rear-hand straight punch with a hip turn
Sword_Idle: standing ready with a sword in the right hand
Spell_Simple_Enter: raises a hand to ready a spell
Pistol_Idle_Loop: standing ready, pistol held low in both hands
Pistol_Aim_Neutral: two-handed pistol aim, level (a pose to blend with up and down)
Hit_Chest: takes a blow to the chest: torso snaps back, recovers
Hit_Head: takes a blow to the head: head snaps aside, recovers
Death01: staggers and falls flat on the back
Interact: reaches forward at chest height and works something with the hands (a lever, a door, a box)
PickUp_Table: reaches out and picks something up from table height
Push_Loop: leans in and shoves something heavy, stepping
Fixing_Kneeling: kneels on one knee and works with both hands near the ground
Sitting_Enter: sits down onto a seat (no chair is drawn)
Driving_Loop: seated, hands on a steering wheel, small turns
Dance_Loop: a one-second groove: hips sway, arms swing out
Idle_FoldArms_Loop: standing with the arms folded across the chest, shifting weight: waiting, listening
Yes: agrees: raises the left hand out in front (a thumbs-up), holds it, lowers it
Idle_TalkingPhone_Loop: on the phone: right hand at the ear, left arm across the body
Idle_Lantern_Loop: standing, holding a lantern out in front in the right hand
Idle_Rail_Loop: leaning forward on the forearms, as over a railing
Idle_Rail_Call: leaning on a railing, raises the right hand to wave or call out, then leans back on it
Walk_Carry_Loop: walking with a box held in both arms in front, in place
Zombie_Idle_Loop: hunched and swaying, arms hanging: a zombie at rest
Zombie_Walk_Fwd_Loop: shambling, dragging zombie walk, in place
Zombie_Scratch: lunges and claws down with both hands, then settles back
NinjaJump_Start: crouches and leaps into a running ninja's air pose, arms swept back
NinjaJump_Idle_Loop: airborne ninja pose held: body forward, arms swept back
NinjaJump_Land: lands from the ninja leap in a crouch, hands near the ground, and stands
ClimbUp_1m_RM: grabs a ledge about 1 m high and hauls up onto it (travels)
Slide_Start: drops from a run into a feet-first slide on the back
Slide_Loop: sliding feet first, leaning back on one hand
Slide_Exit: springs up out of the slide into a run
Sword_Regular_A: the combo's first strike: crouches and thrusts forward
Sword_Regular_A_Rec: recovers from the first strike back to standing
Sword_Regular_B: the combo's second strike: a low, wide sweeping slash
Sword_Regular_B_Rec: recovers from the second strike back to standing
Sword_Regular_C: the combo's finisher: a big overhead slash down to the ground, then stands
Sword_Regular_Combo: the three strikes chained: thrust, sweep, finisher
Sword_Block: braces and raises the sword to block, then recovers
Idle_Shield_Loop: guarding: the left forearm held across the chest behind a shield
Shield_OneShot: a quick block: snaps the shield arm up across the chest, then lowers it
Idle_Shield_Break: the guard breaks: knocked back off balance with the arms flung out, recovers
Melee_Hook: a big lunging hook swing that carries low to the ground
Melee_Hook_Rec: recovers from the hook back to standing
OverhandThrow: winds up and throws overhand with the right arm, following through
Hit_Knockback: hit hard: thrown back off the feet onto the back, and lies there
Hit_Knockback_RM: hit hard and thrown back onto the back, travelling backward
LayToIdle: gets up from lying on the back to standing
Chest_Open: bends forward and lifts a chest's lid with both hands, then straightens
Consume: eats or drinks: lifts the left hand to the mouth, tips the head, lowers it
Farm_Harvest: bends down and pulls a crop up out of the ground
Farm_PlantSeed: kneels, presses a seed into the soil, stands
Farm_Watering: tips a watering can held in the right hand, sweeping it over the ground
TreeChopping_Loop: chops with an axe: swings from over the shoulder down into a tree
